Wyvern

The Black Tusk superior identified by the codename Wyvern in Extremis Malis, shown directing Mantis's operation without exposing the wider command structure.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Codename in the chain of command

Extremis Malis identifies this superior only as Wyvern. That limited identification is enough to connect Mantis's field work to Black Tusk while preserving the story's view of an intentionally compartmentalized command structure. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    The graphic novel presents Wyvern as the Black Tusk superior receiving Mantis's reports and directing the operation after setbacks in Philadelphia. [1]

  2. confirmed

    Wyvern's communications frame Mantis as an expendable field operative, culminating in Black Tusk silencing Mantis during the Washington sequence. [1]
